fit_reason: Although marked as a private seller, this is dealer stock: the car wears a Minnesota dealer plate, the text links to a dealership website and address, offers dealer financing and a dealer warranty.
findings: Paint on the hood, sides and rear hatch already looks clean and glossy with sharp reflections
Front seat and dash look clean, with a dealer paper floor mat on the driver footwell
message: Hi, we saw your Model Y listing and it already looks clean and glossy in the photos. We're a small mobile detailing team that does pre-sale details and paint correction, and we come to you. If you ever want a quote for future inventory, just let us know.
